note: The brief asks for 15-25 places, but seven landmarks plus up to six extras gives at most 13. This list keeps the 13 and stays within the stated limits. Details for Barbagiuan, Koaland and Zygo Park could not be verified, so their fields are marked for checking on the day.

palace.name: Prince's Palace of Monaco
palace.price_text: About USD 20-30 adults, check on the day
palace.hours: Usually daily in summer, shorter hours in winter; check on the day
palace.tip: Arrive before 11:30 for the changing of the guard at 11:55, which is held daily.

oceano.name: Oceanographic Museum
oceano.price_text: About USD 20-30 adults, check on the day
oceano.hours: Usually daily; check on the day
oceano.tip: Plan about 90 minutes, and see the top aquarium floor before the rooftop terrace.

cathedral.name: Saint Nicholas Cathedral
cathedral.hours: Usually daily, with a midday closure; check on the day
cathedral.tip: Step in quietly for a few minutes; it is a short stop near the palace.

paloma.name: Paloma Beach
paloma.price_text: Public beach, free; loungers cost extra
paloma.hours: Daytime in season; check on the day
paloma.tip: Bring your own towel and water, as the beach is small and busy in summer.
paloma.best: Warm afternoons, late spring to early autumn

barbagiuan.name: Barbagiuan
barbagiuan.tip: Details could not be verified, so confirm the opening and entry rules on arrival.

koaland.name: Koaland
koaland.tip: Details could not be verified, so confirm the opening times and any age limits before visiting.

zygo.name: Zygo Park
zygo.price_text: Free entry, check on the day
zygo.tip: Details could not be verified, so check whether it is open before walking there.

condamine.name: Condamine Market
condamine.price_text: About USD 10-25 for a snack or lunch
condamine.hours: Usually Mon-Sat, mornings; check on the day
condamine.tip: Go in the morning for fresh produce and a quick local lunch at the stalls.

casino.name: Monte Carlo Casino
casino.price_text: Entry fee applies, check on the day; ID and dress code may apply
casino.hours: Usually afternoon to late; check on the day
casino.tip: Bring photo ID and dress smartly, as the rules apply even when you only visit the rooms.

exotic.name: Exotic Garden of Monaco
exotic.price_text: About USD 10-20 adults, check on the day
exotic.tip: Walk the cliff path for sea views over the harbour.

harbour.name: Port Hercule harbour walk
harbour.price_text: Free to walk; boat tours extra
harbour.tip: Walk the marina at dusk to see the yachts lit up.

viewpoint.name: Rock viewpoint at Monaco-Ville
viewpoint.tip: Stand on the rock edge for the best view of the harbour and the coast.

oldtown.name: Monaco-Ville old town walk
oldtown.price_text: Free to walk; guided tours extra
oldtown.tip: Start at the palace square and wander the narrow streets; allow time for photos.
